concerns.text: Missing execution tasks for mandatory artifacts: T006a (preprocess) and T006b (run) are unchecked, yet T017 depends on `prompts.csv`. T006d (run diverse) is unchecked, blocking T017. T022b (derive matrices) is unchecked, blocking FR-003 and T022c. These are critical execution steps required to satisfy FR-001, FR-003, and FR-009.

Missing execution task for US2: T028 (load matrices) is unchecked. T029 (run router inference) explicitly depends on T028 to load `clustering_report.json`. Without T028, the router cannot function, violating FR-004 and US2 acceptance criteria.

Missing implementation tasks for US3/Polish: T037 (code cleanup) and T038 (performance optimization) are unchecked. While 'cleanup' is vague, T038 is critical for the 'Compute Constraints' assumption in the plan (streaming MS-COCO). Without a task to implement streaming, the plan's assumption that the pipeline handles memory bottlenecks is unverified.

Missing robustness tasks: T042 (fail-loud data), T043 (proxy fallback), T044 (streaming refactor), and T045 (matrix orthogonality check) are unchecked. These are required to satisfy Spec Edge Cases (Proxy Failure, Outliers) and Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene). Without them, the system lacks defined failure modes for critical edge cases.

Stale/Inconsistent tagging: T006a, T006b, T006d, T022b, and T028 are marked with `[P]` (parallel) but are unchecked, implying they are incomplete or pending. The `[P]` tag suggests they are ready to run, but the unchecked status contradicts this. Either mark them as complete (if artifacts exist) or remove the `[P]` tag if they are blocked.
